scripts.build: npm run build -w @team517/contracts && npm run build -w @team517/functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck -w @team517/mobile && npm run typecheck:trust-fixtures
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @team517/functions
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-team517 --only auth,firestore "npm run test:integration -w @team517/functions"
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-team517 --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-team517 --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:smoke -w @team517/functions"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-team517 --only auth,firestore,functions --ui "tsx functions/test/mobile-flow.ts"
